title: Prove the sharp rank-one two-call P112 COPY floor
body:
Closes the arbitrary directed rank-(1,1) residual in PR2395’s two-call P112 root-code model: every exact factorization has COPY-rank sum at least128, attained by the sixteen separate coordinate terms. This includes the zero-minimum-cross-price case that the prior count criterion leaves undecided.

The new written proof combines actual support annihilators with coefficient ranks. Mixed exceptional orientations give double price16. For the remaining same-side cases, paid pure ranks reduce every possible sub128 bill to one cost127 equality pattern. Source-coordinate rigidity and diagonal dual bases then force a nonzero cross coefficient that cannot cancel. Exceptional indices may differ, cross forms are independent, and coefficient scalings are arbitrary complex nonzero values.

The exact verifier independently rechecks the112-root support census,64 support pairings, mixed transfers and rigidity controls. It binds the predecessor’s actual unresolved fixture and includes a distinct directed fixture with a genuine price15 double and exact cost129 decoder; that fixture is not presented as optimal. The128 attainer is separate. Transposition, non-unit scaling, missing endpoint, wrong free-column and relaxed127 controls are included.

Validation: registered normal and optimized Python3.12 checks PASS; committed-byte/source-history checks PASS; official10-file export integrity PASS; Git-free cold normal/optimized replays PASS in0.42/0.33s. Actual optimized cold mutations also reject a price0→false receipt and a missing RESULT.json. Proof and verifier independently reviewed; this is a written theorem with finite source checks, not a Lean certificate. No physical chart, ownership, precision, recursion, complete multiplication theorem or kappa change is claimed. Rank-(1,2) and higher residual classes remain outside scope.

Sources and attribution: commdata2338 PR2395, Sagar Thakrar PR2294, and alephnan’s original P112 work; exact base/blob/SHA pins in SOURCES.json. Prepared for JoyboyBrian with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. New work Apache-2.0.
